content: For this competition we'll be creating a dataset of the top episodes each day. This should help in reviewing replays as well as training agents. Each new dataset will be added to the index here: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/kaggle/pokemon-tcg-ai-battle-episodes-index

@bovard Thank you, this is really helpful!

Could you add each team's score (rating) to the dataset? Right now the replay JSON only has the team names and the win/loss result (+1/-1) — there's no rating in it.

For each episode, it would be great to have, for both teams:

the rating before or after the episode
Adding to this, I would want to have each agent's agent_id in the json file.
Thank you for all the valuable data! If it is at all possible to share, what criteria is being used for which episodes get included in each day's index?
We rate the episodes by highest average participant rating. This will bias the dataset towards the episodes from the top competitors.
